title: Obama on James Corden about unidentified objects
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Obama on James Corden about unidentified objects, about 2021 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: where I think on James Corden, he goes, "There are things in our sky that, you know, we can't identify. We don't know what they are."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls that in 2021 former US President Barack Obama went on the late-night talk show of James Corden. According to Michels, Obama said there are things in our sky that we cannot identify and do not know what they are. Michels tells it as a sign that even a former president openly admits the mystery is real.
